Whether or not the of Service entered into by Mavor Pelenio of Marihatag, Surigao del Norte is valid notwithstanding the absence of a prior authority from the Sangguniang Bayan? This Department is bereft of the authority to pass upon the validity of the contracts entered into by LGUs. Nonetheless, the query may be addressed without passing upon the issue on validity. Based on Section 22 (c) of the Code, it is clear that no contractual obligations may be entered into by the local chief executive in behalf of the LGU without prior authorization by the sanggunian concerned, unless otherwise provided in the Code. The authority of the local chief executive (LCE) to employ emergency or casual employees or laborers hired through job orders for local projects authorized by the. sanggunian pursuant to Section 77 of the Code should not be read as an unqualified authority granted to the LCE as the Code does not categorically declare the same as exemption to Section 22 (c). Moreover, it may be inferred that the authority to employ emergency or casual employees or laborers through job orders is part and parcel of the authorization issued by the sanggunian for the local project. Lastly, it should be emphasized that the authority of the municipal mayor to represent the municipalit-y is highlighted under Section 444 (b) (1) (vi) of the Code, i.e., through contracts upcn prior authority of the sangguniang bayan; pursuant to law; or ordinance.
